sloka: बाढम् इति एव तम् राजा मुनिः च समभाषत ।लीलया स धनुर् मध्ये जग्राह वचनात् मुनेः ॥१-६७-१५॥
transliteration: bāḍham iti eva tam rājā muniḥ ca samabhāṣata ।līlayā sa dhanur madhye jagrāha vacanāt muneḥ ॥1-67-15॥

translations.english: The king as also the rishi said "Be it so". At the words of the sage (Viswamitra), he (Rama) took hold of the bow by the its middle with ease:
